note: Long-standing classical problem in differential geometry of curves. Documented as a standing problem by at least Grinevich and Schmidt (1990s), but no single documented origination point found. The problem asks for necessary and sufficient conditions on two periodic functions (curvature and torsion, or curvature alone in plane case) that determine when an integral (Frenet) curve is closed. No Wikipedia article on this specific problem exists; it appears only in lists of unsolved problems.
